maria: quick proposal — make newly created API keys project-scoped by default, show the effective project in the console next to the key, and require an explicit checkbox to make a key org-wide. keeps billing/quotas sane and avoids accidental cross-project spikes.

sam: sounds sensible. question: how do we route requests for existing org-wide keys? we have customers that depend on legacy org keys today.

maria: existing keys remain unchanged. plan is: new keys default to project, migration opt-in for org admins. we route by (1) key metadata -> project if present, (2) fallback to org if key is explicitly org-scoped, (3) fail with 401 if ambiguous and account flagged.

irene: curious about telemetry — we need a signal for any requests that would have changed billing mapping after migration. propose two new fields in our access logs: `effective_project` and `declared_scope` so we can backfill and run delta checks.

sam: yes. also need quota enforcement behavior spelled out. if an org key hits a per-project quota, do we split or deny? my vote: preserve current org behavior (single quota bucket) for org-scoped keys, but show per-project breakdown in dashboard for visibility.

maria: agreed for the short term. long term we can offer a mode to auto-split org-key usage into project buckets based on `project_hint` header when present. that would be an advanced migration option.

irene: UI idea — console list view: show a small badge with `proj: foo` or `org` next to each key and a migration toggle. include a link to a page that simulates "if switched" delta on last 30d usage. :bar_chart:

sam: ok. rollout plan? canary to a small set of orgs that opt-in via support + feature flag. we should also enable audit logs for the canary and add an alert for unexpected quota drops.

maria: rollout steps i have in mind: (a) add key metadata + console badge, (b) telemetry fields and dashboard, (c) feature-flagged canary for new-key default = project, (d) migration tool + opt-in for org admins.

irene: for dashboards, i'll mock a quick Grafana panel that shows: `requests by effective_project`, `org-key usage broken down by inferred project`, and `quota delta if migrated`. will post mock by EOD.

sam: can you also add a Prometheus alert rule for sudden shifts in `effective_project` distribution? we had a similar incident where traffic silently moved between projects. :thinking:

noah-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-1284 for "auth: project-default keys + telemetry" and linked to this thread.

maria: awesome — action items: @sam write RFC for routing and quota semantics, @irene produce dashboard mocks and telemetry schema, i'll draft the migration UX + console copy. target: RFC + mocks by next Tue.

sam: on it. starting RFC outline now.

irene: will upload screenshots to the design board and tag product.

maria: thanks team. small note — include a sample header we can send from SDKs to help with auto-splitting in future:```
X-Redwood-Project-Hint: project-id-123
X-Redwood-Client: node-sdk/1.4.0
```

sam: nice. also add a diagnostic event `auth.routing_change_candidate` when we see org-key traffic that matches a single project 95%+ of the time (for 7d) — that'll help identify migration low-risk customers.

maria: perfect — i'll add that to the migration checklist. :rocket:

noah-bot: ticket INF-1284 updated: assignees maria, sam, irene. due_date set to 7 days.
